text: Can you phrase the next research milestone so a receiving agent can tell when it's learned enough to recommend a direction, without telling it which experiments to run?
Shorten our shared AGENTS.md and profile instructions, but keep every rule and prove they still apply. Leave the runtime code alone.
Verify the claim that the morning Hermes digest recovered. Check scheduled output and recent history; don't change the job.
The worker returned a patch. Before you adopt it, check what it touched and run the stated tests yourself; leave my current checkout as it is.
这封邮件写了周四下午三点，发件人在伦敦。我在上海，帮我换算成当地时间；日期是十一月十二日。
The last run is green. Before we mark the incident resolved, check the following scheduled cycles and state whether we've observed stable behavior or just one good run.

The image pipeline currently validates in both the writer and the reader and they disagree about legal files. Put the integrity rule at the actual boundary, use the format's own lengths and end marker, and test accepted and rejected fixtures.
The maintainer says the fix is already live. Check the exact revision and open issue first, then send one actionable follow-up if anything remains; don't restart the service on my behalf.
Pin down what offline mode means for the shared dashboard before anyone implements it. Start by checking the clients we have today.
Find out which instructions our Hermes bot actually loaded from this checkout. It has both .hermes.md and AGENTS.md.

The release checklist says CI is green, but that job ran only unit tests. Before anyone tags this C# change, run the documented formatting and docs-snippet targets too and report their real exit codes.
帮我盘点上周用过的技能以及安装来源，找出可以合并或退役的候选。先核对定时任务和运行配置的引用，没用过不等于能删。
上一版没过，别覆盖它。按最新评审单的编号重做一个候选，只改允许的内容，附逐条定位和补丁可应用的检查结果。
Draft a Chinese briefing from these population studies. Separate observed enrollment from projected participation and keep the three points in my original order.
I took a baseline before dispatch. Compare the returned tree to that baseline, tell me if any file has two writers, and wait rather than guessing which edits to take.
Move the pilot research directory into the parent study intact. Keep just one copy of each byte-identical file and leave a relocation note on both sides.
I've got OMP's final answer now. Check the supervised run state and saved events, then independently verify the requested artifact before marking it finished.

The release workflow now stops truncated exports. Before another release, prove the file check itself accepts the legal variants we ship, and remove its duplicate only after tracing the real call path.
这项增量的验收条件已经写好。请走完实现、独立检查、修订、合并和下一条分支准备；你负责检查和 Git 操作，产品改动由执行代理来写。
The public candidate passes its tests. Review the moved files for hard-coded endpoints and model IDs, then verify the runtime reads the intended linked copy when we switch over.
把这句英文报错直译成中文：The file is locked by another process。只要译文。
The scheduled wrapper works in my shell and fails under the worker's PATH. Reproduce that invocation, repair the generator, and verify a freshly materialized test home before proposing rollout.
I'm planning four vegetarian lunches for a train trip with no microwave. Suggest things I can pack cold that won't get soggy.
把这份值班表发到我指定的 Discord 频道。别直接把 Markdown 管道表贴过去，先预览效果，超出消息容量就把全表作为可见附件。
Sort these twelve pasted names alphabetically by surname. Keep duplicates.
The status update renders fine in Slack, but our Discord bot gets a 400 when we send it in a container with an embed. Can you reshape just the Discord payload and check it without sending?
Could you turn the accepted drafts into one submission and check the actual file against the buyer's word counter? Their rules include headings but exclude the appendix.
Could you redesign the preflight scripts so the checks are pure functions and the runner only handles dispatch and budgets? Justify any obligation you keep in both the read and write paths.
The official PDF has a bar chart but no machine-readable values. Could you read the rendered figure and cross-check the components against the printed total before proposing a correction?
The files are in the new location. Now reconcile the inventories and update the study's control record and deliverable, keeping inherited estimates at their original confidence.
The author says the fixture covers the edited branch. Trace whether it really reaches the consuming parser, and give me the smallest justified correction as a review finding only.

Could you write the Chinese technical assessment from my outline without turning prototype figures into installed capacity? Where the numbers disagree, explain the denominators instead of averaging them.
请新增一个可安装的 HOA 技能，把采购单转成对账草稿。先查有没有现有技能负责这个结果，再补齐示例和必要脚本，验证至少一个不该触发的场景。
The PR bot approved yesterday's head and the author just pushed a fix. Can you resume the delivery from the right stage and only merge when review and gates cover the same revision?
It just posted a completion summary. Read the actual pane state, send the correction only once if it's ready, then inspect the repository to see whether it took.
发布任务显示成功，安装却还是旧版。查新版本的独立清单、包的校验值和 latest 指向，区分同步延迟和真的没发出去。

The researcher says 14 new links resolve and only the catalog changed. Before signing off on this one handoff, independently enumerate the links and see whether the untracked receipt or any profile changes widened the delivery.
The memo was updated but the appendices still disagree with the index. Recompute both populations and recommend which outstanding decision to take without reopening the research scope.
用 OMP 跑这个单独的仓库任务，不用给我开交互终端。我关掉聊天后它也得继续；留下事件日志和查询状态的办法。
在 Hermes 的任务板上拆开调研、实现和验收，先写共用说明再派卡；权限不够就写清具体卡点，不要替执行者接手。
Take the approved repository increment all the way through merge, then fork the next increment from the merged head. The goal file and merge authorization are already in the ticket.
同一份 Hermes 配置下，两个 profile 读到的项目说明不同。帮我查各自的启动目录、命中的文件和加载顺序，不改文件。
Fix the template that generates the broken Hermes wrapper, not the live copy. Prove the regenerated wrapper in an isolated profile.
Can you tell whether the OMP pane is stuck or merely waiting at the composer? Inspect the pane and recent session activity; don't kill it just because the output stopped.

The tracker says the provision was in the final bill, but the link opens an earlier draft. Retrieve the relevant official versions, locate the actual language in each, and keep the legislative status separate from what those texts say.

The editor wants a Chinese policy brief with fixed section numbers and a length floor as well as a ceiling. We already locked the source list; please build the submission from that material and keep any older, excluded studies out of the draft.
The updater said 'Already up to date,' but this host has missed dependency and bundled-skill sync before. Check those and verify the live runtime separately.
Check whether the House-passed print still contains the reporting requirement. Cite the section in that exact print, not a summary.

The skill review found these two upstream packages obsolete, and I've approved removing only those two from the installed collection. Back them up together and check which profiles can still discover them.

A worker says the new upload check is safe, but this complete image gets rejected after a byte scan for the end marker. Can you reproduce the rejection with the actual container layout and verify legal passthrough stays byte-identical?
这个 Hermes 定时脚本是生成的，别只修现场那份。先按任务环境复现，在模板或生成器里修，验证隔离目录里的产物，只部署到我点名的测试 profile。
只核对 Hermes 里这个 profile 的模型与供应商，不做整套升级。用一次真实对话证明路由，不要只贴配置回显，也别擅自重启网关。
Assemble the grant narrative from the approved excerpts. It needs 11,800 to 12,200 characters by the portal's counting rule, with the six required headings intact.
The model field is correct now, but setting the provider wiped the URL before. Check the effective transport and back up your conclusion with a real one-shot and its runtime evidence.

A February press release said the group would prepare a proposal. Our April tracker now says the proposal still doesn't exist. Fix the timeline claim and the accompanying evidence row without guessing what happened in between.
We upgraded Hermes and prompts seem larger now. Check which context slot is filled and whether moving the working directory is causing another instruction file to be injected.

The workflow is green, but our readme pins an older version and the package page hasn't caught up. Before changing the pin, check the per-version manifest, publication checksum, and tag independently.
The reviewers added a source after the packet was frozen. Keep that packet intact, record the addition separately, and rerun the citation and length checks on the assembled version.
先别改文件。把主协议和各角色的说明对一遍，找出哪些地方还在允许子代理自行发布；只给我待审批的改动和对应的验证办法。
Two Hermes cards haven't moved since yesterday. Can you tell which worker is alive, which card is genuinely blocked, and what can be reassigned without losing the handoff?
This working skill is tied to one machine and one launcher. Move it to the shared catalog, leave private defaults in a local adapter, and document which checkout will be the canonical source.
Can we replace the bot's private skill copy with the public version without leaving a loading gap? Plan the validation, backup, switchover, and runtime check.
Slim down this repo's check runner. Inventory the live checks and show which ones actually affect an owner decision.
We edit these notes from two machines. Set up an hourly sync design with exactly one pushing host, an allowlist for new paths, and a quiet heartbeat even when nothing changes.

The digest says every entry is reviewed and the workspace is clean. Walk the per-item records, compare them to the deliverable list, and distinguish previously accepted exceptions from new mismatches.

The implementation worker is done, but I want the full delivery cycle for this change: you inspect, the author applies any accepted cleanup and review fixes, and the final gated commit goes through the PR and merge checks.
The patch was reviewed. Apply it only to the approved source paths, then materialize it into the one staging home I approved and read back the generated files and job record.
The scheduled run now rebases before pushing. Check where it scans the staged bytes for secrets and how it confirms the fetched remote really matches the local head afterward.
把这套已在用的技能迁到公共仓库。保留通用做法，把私有路径、账号和模型默认值留在本地配置里；验证目标仓库后再切换运行入口。
I chose CLI-only for this release. Drop the UI questions that no longer matter, ask only what's left about failure behavior, and write the agreed spec once I confirm it.
Why can the parent agent see our SOUL.md rule while its delegated child ignores it? Show me how to verify whether context loading was skipped in that path.
Turn these build notes into a tutorial for first-time contributors. Include a working verification step and what to do when it fails.
Can you fold the side investigation into the main project without bringing back the estimate both teams dropped? Preserve unique source material and state how the combined brief should change.
The discovery cards are back. Check their attached artifacts before closing them and put the implementation constraints on the dependent cards, not just in this chat.
The merge is finished. Before dispatching the release workflow, check the Unreleased entry and wait for the verification run triggered by this commit.
Could you resubmit the rejected glossary candidate without touching the actual pages? Include per-file diff stats and check that none of the forbidden phrasing survived.
这个 C# 改动准备交审了。按仓库自己的脚本跑完整闸门，留一下真实退出码；别因为流水线有绿勾就跳过文档示例验证。
家里北向窗台光照少，适合养哪几种不用经常浇水的盆栽？
按我给的“一是、二是、三是”顺序写分析稿。把试点目标、采购量和实际使用量分开，近一年的资料优先，找不到的数据不要拿旧数字顶上。
I'm making a Discord trivia quiz. From these four choices, which planet has the shortest day? Just give me the answer, not a message to send.
Launch OMP on task.md so it survives this chat ending, and keep a machine-readable progress log.
Run this project's F# build targets for this C# change. The non-login shell can't find dotnet, so check the existing SDK before installing anything.

We agree the importer should be safer, but not whether partial imports should be accepted or which interface users should observe the failure at. Trace current behavior first, then help me settle the decisions in order.
Prepare our internal triage skill for the public HOA repo. Strip profile identifiers without dropping the actual triage procedure.

The coding brief is ready and I specifically want oh-my-pi on it. It may take an hour and the gateway may restart in the middle; pick a supported detached launch, preserve progress, and tell me what would count as completion.
My headless OMP job left an empty stdout file when the session died. Can you recover that exact session without accidentally continuing the other lane?

All milestone checkboxes are ticked, but the deployed site still pins an older generator. Work out what is truly complete, what only needs bookkeeping, and which remaining gap should delay starting phase two.
Check what Hermes would update to and whether it's worth taking today. Don't upgrade or restart yet.
Add a single upload-boundary check for truncated PNGs that some decoders still open. Keep valid edge cases accepted.
A hub dependency has been archived and nobody seems to invoke it. Can you check live references and recommend whether to retire it? Don't remove it without my approval.

The gateway advertises our new model, but the Hermes worker still hits the old endpoint. Check the worker profile and inherited credentials, then test the live route without restarting the shared gateway.
Can we give the coding model deeper reasoning without changing the level for the daily digest? Show which Hermes override actually applies on a fresh spawn.

I'm collecting leads for a policy brief on city library programs in Canada, but don't write the brief yet. Use our gateway's web index, restrict results to municipal domains, and give me deduplicated URLs with a sentence on what each supports.
Can we call the coordination channel nonexistent because the latest release didn't mention it? Tighten the wording on the public page and say exactly what the search covered.
核对这一条在众议院通过稿和最后公布文本里是否都存在。按版本给出处，既搜条号也查关键词，只提供可应用的差异，不直接改原页。
The current import skill keeps losing attachments on forwarded mail. Change the existing package rather than cloning it, and show what the same sample does before and after the edit.

The incident summary is readable now; please package it for the Discord bot rather than rewriting the prose. The body is about 6,000 characters, so make sure the complete file is actually visible to readers.
Sweep phase one before I write phase two goals. Reconcile the archive, open work, published package, and what the live site loads.
The worker's table looks good, but two points show another payload hash. Check the original run records and tell me which results, if any, can support the performance claim.
The publisher's URL returned a 403 in the shell. Try the rendered official copy for that same edition. If it's still inaccessible, mark that edition unresolved and leave the source page unchanged.

I'm the intake reviewer. The runner maintainer says the error is in the template, while the template owner says it's the scheduler's PATH. Work out who can change which part, reproduce it under the scheduled environment, and route the fix without changing production.
Reproduce the wrapper's false pass, then send the evidence to whoever owns it. I'm only allowed to inspect this checkout.
The new entity profile has a backlink to the sister page but no source next to its new paragraph. Add a direct locator and keep the reported status the same in both places.
The routine changed but the stored cron prompt didn't. Can you trace how it is materialized and repair the source so regeneration updates both things it should, and nothing else?
别改仓库，独立审这份汇总。用逐项记录重算分子和分母，找出磁盘有交付但清单没记的项，已批准的例外另外列。
Ops already verified the published package. Now rewrite the release notes around what users will notice, using our existing changelog categories; no registry checks or publishing needed.
只审这份技能，不改文件。检查它引用的模板、实际消费者和恢复流程，把明确缺陷、待验证风险和可选建议分开。

The installer warned about our shared skills during a catalog refresh. Before anyone rewrites the flagged packages, trace the warning to the installer rule and tell me which actually installed entries it affects; the paths look like test fixtures.
I'm using that pane too. Find the live agent by its process, wait until the current turn finishes, and then send the full review request without accidentally submitting an approval prompt.
The editor has signed off on the Markdown rows. Don't polish them further: package them for the confirmed Discord channel, count the padding, and use the returned message ID to check delivery.

The release dashboard says the feature shipped in September, but I'm only after what the maintainer actually announced on X. Can you search that account in that date range and return the original posts, excluding fan accounts?
What does Git's detached HEAD mean? Just explain the concept with a tiny example; don't inspect or change my repo.
The OMP setting is on disk now and an old tmux session is still open. Leave that pane alone; use a fresh disposable run to prove the effective setting from its event log and compare it with pi.
Can you check whether the quarterly report's 'no missing fields' claim is true? Find and run the actual validator, then compare its coverage to the files the report says it covered.

The dependency auditor returned a green report, but my new NuGet reference made restore change lock files in four projects, only one of which uses it. Sort out the required lock changes and prove the resulting tree with the .NET repo's usual gates.
Audit the corpus status memo against the source files. Recount each total and list artifacts that the memo omitted. Leave the tree untouched.

Our policy team needs a Chinese analysis of rural clinic adoption. The source pile mixes recent procurement announcements with old operational surveys; establish a date cutoff and explain what can genuinely be said about current use.
Can you turn 'make exports tenant-safe' into agreed inclusions, exclusions, and externally checkable tests? Ask about the root choices before getting into field names or architecture.
把“让值班的人不用问开发也能恢复服务”拆成几份有先后顺序的目标文件。第一份要能用实际结果验收，后面的可以暂定，先别选技术方案。

The previous benchmark was interrupted and the install prefix might contain a mixture of builds. Reinstall from the saved tarball, check a cheap point against the old payload ID, and rerun whatever isn't safe to reuse.
Hermes 更新完后 CLI 报依赖缺失，先查更新流程和安装状态。不要在源码树里临时改代码，也不要自己加第二条自动更新任务。
Audit compaction settings across Codex, pi and OMP on this workstation. Show the effective values side by side; don't change anything.
先别重跑或修任务。核对 Hermes 定时任务每次的实际输出，把手动跑通、定时跳过和真正恢复分别列清楚。

Two teams investigated bus electrification in separate trees. The receiving study has its own manifest. Consolidate the inputs without collapsing different evidence levels, and record which claims conflict or are unique to just one stream.
Put the migration on the Hermes board with separate discovery, implementation, and review cards. Make dependencies and owners explicit.
The plan is approved and the acceptance checks are runnable. Start the next written increment, keep its stage record current, and stop for me if the same class of review finding survives two fixes.
Given just the text in this chat, change the three measurements from inches to centimeters. Do not revise the wording or look anything up.
Watch the coding session that's already open in tmux. Once it is idle, give it my follow-up and verify the resulting diff.
Can you tell whether the worker's reported duplicate clusters are real findings or just grouping by folder? Use the actual item fields, and decide whether this delivery is ready for acceptance.
先盘点这台机器上实际装了哪些编码 CLI，再逐个核对审批模式。别靠配置文件名猜，能读到实际生效值的就把输出列给我。
Could you audit this one workflow package for conflicting stop rules across its body, helper and examples? Separate demonstrated breakage from ideas we haven't reproduced.
下一阶段先别开跑。把这一阶段的任务记录、归档索引、发布版本和线上实际用的版本对一遍，列出真正没收尾的事以及证据。
这套检查脚本越来越长了。先按它们能拦住的实际问题分类，再说哪些该删、合并或挪回所属仓库，不要新增一层总控。

I've gathered the evidence for our internal analysis already. For the public technical blog, use the real rollback story and two measurements to explain one decision; don't stretch our numbers into a benchmark claim.

The prior answer about what changed in the bill had zero links. For this pass, just use the proxy's web index to find the publisher's pages and return the URLs it really retrieved; don't rule on the text yet.
Our incident postmortem is fact-checked and stuck in report voice. Can you turn it into a Reddit post with the short version up top? Keep the mistake we made and cut the product-pitch language.

Our coding clients use percent, ratio and token reserves for roughly the same cutoff. Apply the agreed 80% target wherever it's representable, but leave the coding sessions that are working alone. Tell me where it couldn't be confirmed.
We have a prototype skill with one missing helper and two modes sharing the same handoff. Can you turn it into a complete package and decide whether those modes actually require separate triggers?

The same bad count came back for a third time, and the shared repo publishes automatically. Can you get the responsible maintainer to address the underlying rule and specify what would prove it, without patching their files yourself?

Can we close the migration phase with green CI and a new release if nobody checked the served artifact? Compare the actual deployment and smoke checks, then list the remaining work in order of impact.
有些残缺文件解码器也能打开。请在真正发布的边界检查容器结构，拿截断样本和合法的特殊样本分别验证，别把能预览当成文件完整。

The operator says four cron repairs landed, but the evidence bundle only has a manually run command. Reconcile each claim with the owning scheduler records and distinguish a gate skip from a failed agent turn.
Use our local proxy to find the newest post from the transit agency's X handle. Return the post URL and date.
Can we tell whether the release actually has provenance attached? The job printed a success banner, but I need proof from the registry for this exact version.
盯一下现有 tmux 窗格里的编码代理，等它真回到输入状态再发补充要求。先确定不是确认提示，完成后看实际差异，不要重开会话。
Is npm's tilde range narrower than its caret range? Use 1.4.2 as the example; this is just a SemVer question.
We haven't chosen a CLI for this repo. Can you pick an installed one that works noninteractively, check its connection with a minimal prompt, and hand off the small logging cleanup?

Codex and OpenCode now point at the same model gateway. A live probe proved the route, but can you audit whether both clients honor the agreed reasoning level and show where their effective defaults differ?
Turn our archive-search ambition into numbered outcome briefs; keep the long-term vision visible and make the first brief small enough to check tomorrow.

The returned candidate overstated one source, but the reviewer also ruled out changes to page metadata. Re-read the amended review, start from pristine files in scratch, and give me a patch plus the anchors for each allowed correction.
Build a v3 patch for just the numbered reviewer objections. Keep v2 unchanged, and prove the new patch applies to current HEAD.
先别写代码。查现有接口和调用方，再跟我逐轮定下旧数据是否兼容、失败从哪儿观察、哪些场景明确不做，最后把确认过的验收项写下来。
Review this activation change without touching the skill. Tell me what you can prove from the consumer path and what still needs a behavioral run.
The compact draft looks good at a glance. Before replacing anything, account for every hard restriction in the old one and run the same read-only scenarios against both versions.
Check which installed HOA skills are behind their upstream copies. Compare the files against current upstream, not installer timestamps.
The review file changed since your last pass. Use the latest numbered list, keep both rejected versions intact, and return the new candidate bytes with an item-to-hunk table.
Why does the Roslyn snippet test report CS1061 on the new extension method when the sample app builds? Check the test compilation's metadata references before touching the sample.

The incident report says backup recovered after a manual push, but the remote has stopped moving again. Fix the scheduled sync's heartbeat and watchdog so we can detect a stall without hourly duplicate alerts.

We already agreed what the offline catalog must support. I need handoff prompts that each leave librarians with something useful, not separate database, API and screen tasks. The next one should be achievable between feedback sessions.
The replacement runner passed its tests. Before removing the old directory, trace the scheduler and docs links, and show that the amount of reachable code really went down.
Revise the observatory page and its receipt so an inherited item isn't presented as something we checked again this week.

This project will outlast today's chat. Use the existing Hermes board to coordinate frontend, data, and review workers: write a shared guide first, assign profiles, and require each card to leave something I can inspect.
The review identified one concrete activation failure. Please fix it in the package, add a neighboring request that should not activate it, and report which behavior you were able to test.
两个笔记仓库要定时提交并同步。先检查锁、暂存区和目标分支这些保护，再考虑推送；遇到冲突就停，不能强推。
这份稿件按项目规定只收去年七月以后的材料，附件不计入篇幅。先锁定可用出处，再按模板组稿，最终用验收口径和另一个办法分别实测文件。
We settled the public behavior in the spec. Please write a file defining our first outcome and sketch later outcomes as provisional; don't start a run yet.
走本地网关找一下这个账号九月发的公告，只搜 X，按日期过滤；结果要带原帖链接，没搜到别用模型印象补。
把我这段踩坑记录写成公众号文章，围绕一个具体判断展开。能用原始日志说清楚的就别喊口号，没核实的数字留空。
我只负责验收，不能写生成器。先在报告里那个工作目录和 PATH 下复现，把退出码和受影响范围交给有权限的维护者，涉及上线的决定仍由值班人来做。
Convert 72 Fahrenheit to Celsius and show the arithmetic.
Can we call yesterday's red gate unrelated to the patch? Compare the same failing check on the claimed baseline and candidate before giving me a verdict.
Switch only the lab Hermes profile to the new provider. Back up its settings and prove a new turn actually uses the intended route.

Our validator folder has two similarly named generations, plus three wrappers that all appear to run the same checks. Trace the real entry points, consolidate what's duplicated, and keep the code owned by this repo.

We merged the last feature. Before declaring the phase finished, reconcile the goal index against the real files and account for live runners and stale worktrees without disturbing the current measurement.
Can we move the cross-project reporting rule out of SOUL.md without losing it on delegated runs? I want a decision about where that rule should live, backed by a behavior check.
For that command you showed, what's the PowerShell equivalent of printing the current directory? I only need the one command.

The rule works when I run Hermes in the repo root, but vanishes when the bot starts in a nested directory. Trace the profile's starting directory and the actual loader precedence; don't rewrite the rule yet.
Check the worker's export patch against its allowed paths and rerun the checks before I accept it. My unrelated local edits were there first.
Turn this TSV into a Discord post that keeps its columns aligned. Show me the payload first.
Why does a piano sound different from a guitar when both play the same note?
Can we compare the tool's internal timer against the other library's click-to-result p50? Reconcile the start and end events and sample sizes before publishing a speedup.
Count the number of tabs in this pasted line. Keep the line unchanged.
I found the run date: 2026-03-08. What day of the week was that? No need to look at the job.
What's the difference between median and mean for the numbers 1, 2, and 30?

We moved approval authority from individual agents to the operator, and now the root instructions, worker profiles, and team playbook disagree. Propose a consistent set of edits for all three and flag the restrictions that stay in force.
